column1: # The Orca server container (Linux --role server, README section 6.7): directories bind-mounted at the same absolute
# path on the host and in the container. setup.sh creates each one, owned by you, before the container starts.
#   path      {workdir} for --workdir (default ~/orca), otherwise relative to your home directory
#   contents  what lives there (shown by --plan and --check)
# A row in manifest/local/server-mounts.tsv with the same path replaces one here; other rows are added. The rest of
# the container's home is ~/.local/share/orca-setup/home on the host: files written there persist as well, but only
# these paths are your real home directory.
